name: Soft-starter bypass command interface
summary: Requests bypass connection only under the conditions defined by the selected soft starter.
description: Requests bypass connection only under the conditions defined by the selected soft starter. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Soft-starter operating status” at the input and “Bypass contactor command” at the output. Bypass control is product-specific.
